build_vggsfm_tracker: build a VGGSfM tracker model from a local weights file or download from HuggingFace
generate_rank_by_dino: generate a ranked list of representative frames from a batch of images using DINO ViT features
initialize_feature_extractors: initialize feature extractors like ALIKED, SuperPoint, or SIFT for keypoint detection
extract_keypoints: extract keypoints from a query image using pre-initialized feature extractors
predict_tracks_in_chunks: predict visual tracks from query points in memory-efficient chunks using a track predictor
